title: Syrian Shrimp Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Syria, made with shrimp, spices, and a rich tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the charred tomatoes and yummy sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
